start.text: The temporal distortion field settles into absolute, deafening silence. You stand at the center of the world's ruined grid—the absolute pinnacle of the high citadel tower or the quiet radioactive edge of the empty wasteland. The skies have stopped bleeding crimson static; instead, they have locked into an unmoving, iridescent cosmic crystal sheets. Your historical database parameters have finished running their calculations on every action you chose. Whether you betrayed your closest mentors, slaughtered ancient emperors, or mutilated your own physical flesh to shield the weak, your free will has successfully broken the old economic tracking matrix. The universe now stands entirely frozen, waiting for your final thought to permanently lock in the ultimate legacy shape of the cosmos.
start.name: System

choices.text: 👑 [CONFIRM RUTHLESS STATUS] Unleash the ultimate planetary transaction lock code to seal your tyrannical empire
🕊️ [CONFIRM HEROIC STATUS] Disperse your final remnants of energy to dissolve the concept of gold magic forever

tyrant_climax.text: You place your bare, violet-glowing hand onto the master mainframe glass console. The encryption algorithms you stole from Mansa Musa II and Emperor Nero integrate seamlessly into your gold scar. A low, terrifying sub-atomic hum shakes the foundations of the entire tectonic plate. The parasite inside your head merges fully with your brain stem, stripping away your final remnants of human empathy. Across the continents, millions of surviving citizens and cowering soldiers instantly freeze as a sudden, pulsing tracking rune burned into their skin. Their minds are pulled straight into your central network grid, making their thoughts, their bodies, and their financial transactions completely transparent to your single mental interface. You have built a flawless, permanent empire of precious metal.
tyrant_climax.name: The Golden Sovereign

choices.text: Step out onto the eternal throne balcony to witness your silent museum world

hero_climax.text: You drag your frail, bleeding human frame toward the cracked central terminal. Without the parasite, your body feels incredibly cold, but your mind is perfectly quiet for the first time since you snapped awake in the penthouse apartment. You manually configure the network bridge to execute a total planetary overload sequence. You draw the remaining rogue current of the Greek lightning, the Egyptian solar fire, and the Roman mechanical weapons directly into your own chest cavity, acting as a final living ground wire. The pain is a blinding white fire that shears your nerve endings apart, but you hold onto the terminal levers with everything you have left. The tracking network shatters, its glass cables cracking open all over the map.
hero_climax.name: Musa

choices.text: Plunge the levers down completely to let the light wash the planet clean

abyssal_tyrant_ending.text: EPILOGUE: You step out onto the high citadel balcony, looking over a silent planet. There are no more wars, no more debts, and no more rebel movements—because every living being has been frozen into a pristine, unmoving solid gold statue. The oceans have settled into a smooth, burning mirror of molten bullion reflecting a dead purple sun. Zeus's lightning rod, Nero's mechanized armor, and Ramses's sun temples have all been melted down into the foundation blocks of your colossal cosmic throne room. You have achieved absolute free will, absolute dominion, and absolute financial ownership of the universe. Yet, as you look across your quiet world museum, you realize the Aurum Worm has left your mind completely alone in an empty void. You sit upon your throne of gold skulls, reigning over an eternal graveyard for the rest of time. [THE RUTHLESS MYTHOLOGICAL TYRANT ENDING REACHED]
abyssal_tyrant_ending.name: System

choices.text: 🔄 Reset the Cosmic Cycle (Return to Main Menu)

immortal_martyr_ending.text: EPILOGUE: A colossal wave of warm amber light erupts from your chest, washing across the entire globe like a beautiful, silent dawn. The tracking runes burn away completely from the skin of every survivor, and all corporate debts are permanently erased from the memory banks of history. The concept of gold magic and divine parasitic currency evaporates into nothingness, banishing the Roman, Greek, Egyptian, and Norse pantheons back into harmless myths and children's storybooks. Your name is completely wiped from the archives to protect the timeline, leaving you forgotten by the very people you saved. Generations from now, humans will look up at the morning sky and feel a mysterious warmth, never knowing it was paid for by your final heartbeat. You fade peacefully into the light, leaving behind a free, ordinary world. [THE IMMORTAL HUMAN MARTYR ENDING REACHED]
immortal_martyr_ending.name: System

choices.text: 🔄 Reset the Cosmic Cycle (Return to Main Menu)

defeat.text: Your survival vitality hits 0%. The golden tracking runes on your skin shatter as your life force fades into the dark rain.
defeat.name: System
